title: Sable and the Colony
author: Jude Marchetti
blurb: Mara Nakamura, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
